moa: atypical antipsychotic (olanzapine) combined with opioid antagonist (samidorphan)

approval_evidence.quote: Initial U.S. Approval: 2021 (LYBALVI, olanzapine and samidorphan tablets, highlights)

launch_evidence.quote: product sales, net consist of sales in the U.S. of VIVITROL, ARISTADA and ARISTADA INITIO and, following its commercial launch in October 2021, LYBALVI, primarily to wholesalers

series_start_reason: First quarter with a LYBALVI sales figure. The 2022 Q2 and Q3 10-Qs print the 2021 six- and nine-month LYBALVI columns as nil, and the fourth-quarter 2021 release prints 8,215 thousand USD for the quarter and the year.
notes: One line only: the LYBALVI row of the product sales, net table, U.S. product sales (the note states product sales are sales in the U.S.). Not a company total: VIVITROL, ARISTADA and LUMRYZ are separate rows and are not in this series. Calendar quarters = fiscal quarters (Alkermes plc reports on the calendar year). Q1-Q3 of each year come from that quarter's own 10-Q; Q4 comes from the fourth-quarter earnings release, which prints the quarter as current. Each year's four quarters sum to the full-year figure printed in the same release or the 10-K (checked by script, exact). The verifier's Q4 sum check reads the fifth figure of a five-figure release line as the year total and so reports every year 2022 to 2025 as a mismatch; the arithmetic above is correct and that check is a layout limitation.
search_log: data.sec.gov submissions for Alkermes plc (CIK 0001520262) listed every 10-Q, 10-K, 10-K/A and Item 2.02 8-K from 2015 to 2026; every primary document was downloaded from sec.gov Archives and the LYBALVI row searched in each table (bs4 over table rows).
Each earnings-release 8-K's EX-99.1 was downloaded from its index.json and searched for the LYBALVI row; Q4 values were taken from the quarterly table of the fourth-quarter release (2021 to 2025).

No LYBALVI dollar line appears in the 2015-2021 filings before the 2021 Q1 10-Q (the 2021 10-Qs print LYBALVI only as a percentage-change row); the first dollar figure is 8,215 thousand USD in the fourth-quarter 2021 release.
Full-year cross-check: 2022 quarters sum to 96,022 (FY2022 10-K), 2023 to 191,889, 2024 to 280,032, 2025 to 346,687, each as printed in the 10-K.
FDA: accessdata label 213378s000lbl.pdf (2021) prints 'Initial U.S. Approval: 2021' (text checked with pdfplumber).
Launch month October 2021 from the 2022 10-Q note (launch_evidence).
